## react-big-schedule 9.0.1

- **New website**: documentation, live demos and the theme playground now live at https://react-big-schedule.ansulagrawal.com. The npm page and the README link to it.
- README reduced to the essentials; the full API reference moved to the website.
- The old examples app is removed from the repository (no change to the published package).
- Release workflow: a `patch` PR label now publishes a stable patch version.
